scope: Independent read-only review of saved kernel9 boot and service evidence, accepted kernel8 boot evidence, and stock fallback baseline. No SSH or device operation.
recommended_summary: Kernel9 reached normal services within the observed startup window. No new kernel fault or driver ABI error was found; the pre-existing wireless/regulatory/license diagnostic families remain. This supports bounded boot acceptance, not all-SSID or long-duration stability certification.

fatal_kernel_fault_scan.pattern: Kernel panic|\bOops:|\bBUG:|WARNING: CPU:|Unable to handle kernel|Call trace:|soft lockup|hard LOCKUP|rcu.*stall|INFO: task.*blocked for more than|Out of memory:|oom-kill|segfault|SQUASHFS error|EXT4-fs error|Buffer I/O error|blk_update_request: I/O error|disagrees about version of symbol|Unknown symbol|invalid module format|bad page state|refcount_t:|list_del corruption
fatal_kernel_fault_scan.conclusion: No panic, Oops, BUG, warning backtrace, lockup/stall, OOM, kernel access fault, explicit filesystem/block I/O failure, or module symbol/version failure was observed.
fatal_kernel_fault_scan.false_positive_handling: oops_mmc is a crash-capture module name; proprietary/out-of-tree taint and the temperature-warning interrupt registration are not crash reports.

baseline_error_comparison.normalization: Removed ANSI color; replaced MAC addresses, SSID strings and long hexadecimal pointers for comparison. Error codes and operation text were preserved.
baseline_error_comparison.method_limit: Equality of message families does not prove every runtime operation is correct or establish long-run performance.

findings.observation: At 159.65 s the early snapshot has no cfg_client process, an empty master value and a 2024 pre-sync wall clock. By 223.13 s and again 229.43 s, cfg_client PID 10680 and the expected controller are present; wall clock reads 2026-10-04. The boot_id is unchanged.
findings.assessment: The early service gap resolved during the observed startup; do not label it persistent AiMesh failure or an extra reboot. The capture does not independently identify which time-sync daemon performed the update.

findings.observation: At the confirmed capture, node-history and CCR error files are 0 bytes; sample/result ages are 26 and 22 seconds respectively against 2026-10-04 13:14:46 UTC.
findings.assessment: Collectors resumed and produced fresh data after clock convergence. Full semantic correctness of every reported topology/device/port is outside this log audit.

findings.observation: Exactly 4 AP bring-up failures: bssidx 1 twice and bssidx 2 twice, matching kernel8 and stock.
findings.assessment: No new time64-related virtual-BSS failure family appears. Existing failure messages are still unresolved signals; physical-radio isup does not validate every Guest/IoT SSID or client.

findings.observation: The same 2 regulatory.db missing/load-failure lines occur in all baselines.
findings.assessment: Not introduced by kernel9; effective proprietary channel/country policy is not established by these messages.

findings.observation: Same missing default-license/OUI candidate-load failures, followed by BP3 provisioned and 2 HTOA-license-present messages.
findings.assessment: No evidence of lost active acceleration licensing. This is not a throughput benchmark.

findings.observation: Event-buffer errors 3, CAC setup failures 3, unsupported OCV 8, IGMP send failures 8 and scan aborts 4 match kernel8. Deauthorize failures are 2 versus kernel8=1; kernel8 review records 2 in its kernel6 baseline.
findings.assessment: Extra deauthorize occurrence is not a newly observed failure family and separate-boot count variance does not isolate a kernel9 regression. Existing transient connection behavior remains outside a long-soak guarantee.

findings.observation: Both 10 Gbps physical links show startup down/up transitions, as in kernel8 and stock. Early health has a 2-member 802.3ad aggregate, both members up at 1 Gbps full duplex with 0 link-failure counts.
findings.assessment: No persistent wired-down or LACP failure is shown. Link-transition counts are boot observations, not a sustained traffic test.

findings.observation: Root SquashFS mounted read-only; existing ext4 data/JFFS/AI partitions mounted read-write. Tuxera modules report running on #9 without accompanying invalid-module-format or symbol/version failures.
findings.assessment: No boot-time storage or module ABI failure found. No claim of exercised I/O for every filesystem module.

limitations: Observation ends at 229.43 seconds of this boot; no long-duration load, roaming or repeated-reboot stability claim.
Time64 correctness is covered by separate raw-syscall/glibc tests, not proved by a quiet boot log.
Per-SSID beacon/client recovery, every Ethernet port and physical RGB color require their own checks.
Bootloader automatic fallback behavior and permanent boot-slot commit are not established or performed by this review.
